data_description.device_grouping: Flat = one HA device per internet module (parameters, connectivity, alarms, activity). Group by menu = parameter entities on menu child devices (via_device); connectivity, alarms, and activity stay on the parent module device. Changing remaps device membership (automations/dashboards).
